meta.title: Citation register
meta.method: Each document below was fetched and read during this session. Quotes are short extracts used to substantiate a specific claim. Documents marked restricted could not be read; they establish nothing and are listed so the gap stays visible.
meta.honesty_note: Where a claim could not be tied to a document, it is not made. Two claims that other sessions had not recorded are captured here: the star-rating prohibition and the price-display condition, both of which change what a compliant affiliate page may show.

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.claim: The required disclosure statement, and that it must be stated clearly and prominently on the site.
sources.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following … on your Site …: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”

sources.title: Associates Program Policies
sources.claim: Four rules that constrain this site: prices may only be shown when Amazon serves the link or the data comes via the Product Advertising API; star ratings may not be shown without API access; link shorteners must not obscure that a link goes to Amazon; price tracking and alerting are prohibited; and a purchase made through an intermediate site without an affirmative action there is disqualified.
sources.quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API (§2(t)).

sources.title: Standard Commission Income rate card
sources.claim: Nothing. This URL redirects to an Associates sign-in page, so no commission rate, earnings estimate or revenue forecast is published anywhere on this site.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.section: Where in my blog should I disclose that my review is sponsored by a marketer?
sources.claim: Disclosure placement: a disclosure must be where it easily catches attention and is hard to miss, and a disclosure at the bottom of a page may be missed. This is why the notice sits above the content and is repeated in the footer.
sources.quote: A disclosure should be placed where it easily catches consumers’ attention and is difficult to miss. … Consumers may miss a disclosure at the bottom of a blog or page.

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.publisher: U.S. Federal Trade Commission, via eCFR
sources.dated_on_page: eCFR current as of 2026-11-18; source 88 FR 48102
sources.claim: The operative rule requiring disclosure of a material connection between an endorser and a seller, of which an affiliate commission is the textbook case.

sources.title: Understanding ASINs: Your guide to Amazon's product identification system
sources.section: What does “ASIN” mean? / How to find and use ASIN numbers
sources.claim: ASIN is a 10-character alphanumeric code and appears in a product URL after /dp/. Used to establish that the submitted 9-character short codes cannot themselves be ASINs.
sources.quote: “ASIN” stands for “Amazon Standard Identification Number.” It’s a unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to every product listed in the Amazon store.

sources.title: Amazon listing — Art3d Smoothing Tool Kit (B08FKW9JRM)
sources.section: Title, byline, breadcrumb, About this item
sources.claim: Observed product identity only: brand Art3d, sold by Art3d, wallpaper tools category, kit contents. Establishes what the observed destination is — not what the submitted link was intended to be.

sources.title: Amazon listing — Under-cabinet paper towel holder (B0BSKQW2T2)
sources.section: Title, byline, product details, About this item
sources.claim: Observed product identity: brand niffgaff, aluminium, matte black, 12.2 in rail, 2.56 × 12.2 in, 5 oz, sold by YH Urban.

sources.title: Amazon listing — ORDORA 8-tier pots and pans organizer (B08DY9HRWD)
sources.claim: Observed product identity: brand ORDORA, 8 tiers, four colours, eight heights from 13.78 to 23.62 in, sold by ORDORA Official.

sources.title: Submitted short link 1 — link.amazon/B0hmGG4m2
sources.claim: Resolves to https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08FKW9JRM. The code is 9 characters.

sources.title: Submitted short link 2 — link.amazon/B03QDuGdo
sources.claim: Resolves to https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BSKQW2T2. The code is 9 characters. This URL was submitted twice.

sources.title: Submitted short link 3 — link.amazon/B0hpD2JGQ
sources.claim: Resolves to https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DY9HRWD. The code is 9 characters and shares its B0 prefix with the ASIN it resolves to, which is a coincidence that makes copying the code into an ASIN field especially likely.

constraints.constraint: No prices may be displayed without API access or an Amazon-served link.
constraints.effect_on_site: No price appears anywhere. Price comparison cannot be offered.

constraints.constraint: No star ratings, review counts or review text may be displayed without API access.
constraints.effect_on_site: No rating appears anywhere. A rating column would be a policy breach, not a design choice.

constraints.constraint: No price tracking or price alerting.
constraints.effect_on_site: A price-history or deal-alert feature was excluded deliberately, not overlooked.

constraints.constraint: Filtering or styling a link so it is unclear it goes to Amazon is prohibited.
constraints.effect_on_site: Links are plain, unabbreviated Amazon URLs. No cloaking, no intermediary.

constraints.constraint: A purchase arriving through an intermediate site without an affirmative action there is disqualified.
constraints.effect_on_site: Click tracking may not route the visitor through this domain. A beacon is the compliant pattern.

constraints.constraint: A short code is not an ASIN and must not be recorded as one.
constraints.effect_on_site: Intended and observed fields stay separate; the intended fields remain blank.
